from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from one provided paper regarding its citation relationships."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this specific paper being parsed")
    referenced_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that appear in this paper's reference list or bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
